description: Ancestry distribution and homozygote depletion test for UROC1 p.Trp285Ter
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

Q = """query V($v:String!){ variant(variantId:$v, dataset: gnomad_r4){
  variant_id rsids
  exome{ac an homozygote_count filters populations{id ac an homozygote_count}}
  genome{ac an homozygote_count filters populations{id ac an homozygote_count}} } }"""
def getvar(v):
    return requests.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api", json={"query":Q,"variables":{"v":v}},
        timeout=120, headers={"Content-Type":"application/json","User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}).json()["data"]["variant"]

v854 = getvar("3-126504043-C-T")   # c.854G>A p.Trp285Ter
v855 = getvar("3-126504042-C-T")   # c.855G>A p.Trp285Ter
for nm,v in [("c.854G>A p.Trp285Ter",v854),("c.855G>A p.Trp285Ter",v855)]:
    ex=v["exome"]; print(nm, "| rsid:",v["rsids"], "| filters:",ex["filters"],
                         "| AC=%d AN=%d AF=%.3e hom=%d"%(ex["ac"],ex["an"],ex["ac"]/ex["an"],ex["homozygote_count"]))

POP={"afr":"African/African-American","amr":"Admixed American","asj":"Ashkenazi Jewish","eas":"East Asian",
     "fin":"Finnish","nfe":"Non-Finnish European","sas":"South Asian","mid":"Middle Eastern","remaining":"Remaining"}
pops=[p for p in v854["exome"]["populations"] if p["id"] in POP]
pdf=pd.DataFrame([{"pop":POP[p["id"]],"ac":p["ac"],"an":p["an"],"hom":p["homozygote_count"],
                   "af":p["ac"]/p["an"] if p["an"] else np.nan} for p in pops]).sort_values("af",ascending=False)
print("\nAncestry breakdown of c.854G>A (p.Trp285Ter):")
print(pdf.to_string(index=False))

# HWE: expected homozygotes given observed AF, total AN
ex=v854["exome"]; af=ex["ac"]/ex["an"]; N=ex["an"]/2
exp_hom = af**2 * N
print("\nc.854G>A: N=%d individuals, AF=%.4e -> expected homozygotes under HWE = %.2f; observed = %d"
      %(N, af, exp_hom, ex["homozygote_count"]))
# Poisson test for depletion of homozygotes (null = no selection against biallelic LoF)
p_dep = stats.poisson.cdf(ex["homozygote_count"], exp_hom)
print("Poisson one-sided p for DEPLETION of homozygotes: p=%.3f (large p = no depletion)"%p_dep)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.8))
ax=axes[0]
ax.barh(pdf["pop"],pdf["af"]*100,color="#b4553a")
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.set_xlabel("allele frequency (%)")
ax.set_title("UROC1 c.854G>A (p.Trp285Ter) by ancestry, gnomAD v4 exomes")
for i,(a,h) in enumerate(zip(pdf["af"],pdf["hom"])):
    ax.text(a*100+0.002, i, f"{a*100:.3f}%  (hom={h})", va="center", fontsize=8)

ax=axes[1]
ax.bar(["expected under\nHardy-Weinberg","observed"],[exp_hom, ex["homozygote_count"]],
       color=["#5b6b7c","#b4553a"],width=0.5)
for i,v in enumerate([exp_hom, ex["homozygote_count"]]): ax.text(i,v+0.2,f"{v:.1f}",ha="center")
ax.set_ylabel("p.Trp285Ter homozygotes in gnomAD v4")
ax.set_title("No depletion of UROC1 nonsense homozygotes\n(Poisson one-sided p = %.2f)"%p_dep)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
